title: Equivalence between batches and sample triples
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $m$, there is a bijection between triples of batches, each batch consisting of $m$ sign vectors on $n$ coordinates, and a batch of $m$ triples of sign vectors on $n$ coordinates. The bijection pairs entries with the same index, and its inverse separates each indexed triple into its three coordinate batches.
